name: io.github.kuzenlabs/maviapi-mcp
title: maviapi
description: Live JSON from sites with no API (Booking, Airbnb, Tripadvisor…), plus agent-built APIs for any site

environmentVariables.name: MAVIAPI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: maviapi API key. Optional: without it the server uses the shared demo key (30 requests a minute).

environmentVariables.name: MAVIAPI_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated API slugs to expose as typed per-endpoint tools, or 'all'.
